visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a pale yellow knit cardigan and light blue jeans, sits in the bottom left foreground applying eye makeup with a brush. In the background, a young man in a white t-shirt and grey jeans stands in front of a large, wood-trimmed glass display cabinet. The cabinet contains several designer bags and a small white cat figurine. The man tries on a peach-colored shoulder bag, then switches to a light blue Adidas bowling-style bag with a plush doll attached. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor narrow street or alleyway. The man and woman walk together; the man is carrying a large pink tote bag. He pauses to look at the bag, then they continue walking away from the camera. (3) Back indoors, the woman stands directly in front of the glass cabinet, which is now revealed to be a custom closet system. She speaks and gestures with her hands towards the cabinet. (4) Several fast cuts show the interior of the cabinet, highlighting organized shelves of bags (Coach, Dior) and accessories. A technician in a black shirt holds a laptop showing a technical CAD blueprint of the cabinet structure, pointing at specific measurements on the screen. (5) Two men wearing black 'WOOD LIVING' shirts are seen measuring a cabinet frame with a silver tape measure in a bright room near a window. One man sits and types on a laptop. (6) The woman returns to the frame, standing in front of the cabinet and smiling. A large QR code overlay for LINE appears on the screen. She ends with a dynamic pose, pointing both hands toward the cabinet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop music with female vocals in English starts immediately. The beat is driven by electronic percussion and a bright synth melody. There is no human speech or environmental noise. (2) The song continues at a steady volume while the video shows various scenes of the couple. The acoustic texture is clean and consistent. (3) The BGM volume ducks significantly, transitioning into a soft acoustic guitar bed. A female speaker begins narrating in professional, friendly Mandarin. Her articulation is very clear. (4) A short mechanical click sound is heard, indicating the cabinet door opening, synced with the visual. The narration continues smoothly over the music. (5) Subtle digital 'ding' sounds or UI sound effects play during transitions between technical drawings. The BGM remains light and melodic in the background. (6) The narration reaches a concluding tone with a slightly rising final intonation. The BGM ends with a clean fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Professional Expertise -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the custom cabinetry and closet design services of 'WOOD LIVING' by showing a lifestyle problem (men using women's bags or messy storage) and offering a professional, technical, and quality-guaranteed solution.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand name, display of the company logo on staff uniforms, and a QR code for service booking.
